title: Introduce jurisdictional operator claims, KMS proxy with region affinity, and audit canonicalizer
author: Priya Natarajan
release_notes: Adds jurisdiction-aware operator claims propagation, region-affinitized KMS proxy, RBAC v2 claim->role mapping, and an audit-header canonicalizer; staged rollout behind feature flag and installer CLI toggle.
description: Motivation: operator-initiated requests that used fallback KMS routes could violate tenant residency expectations in multi-geozone deployments. This PR introduces a lightweight KMS proxy with region-affinity routing and a jurisdictional operator-claim propagation middleware that ties RBAC v2 decisions to geozone claims. It also adds an audit header canonicalizer to ensure consistent downstream proofs for compliance ingestion. Changes include a claim backfill migration for existing operator sessions and telemetry for residency decision sampling. Checklist: - [x] design doc and Linear ticket ENG-4521 linked, - [x] RBAC v2 policy and policy tests, - [x] KMS proxy and unit tests, - [x] migration/backfill job and smoke tests, - [x] staged rollout flag + installer hook, - [ ] manual staging canary and runbook signoff. Design references: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4521 and internal design note https://github.com/redwood/internal/designs/kms-region-affinity.md. Rollout plan: feature gate on by default in staging, opt-in via installer flag for dedicated/private customers while telemetry is monitored for 72h before full enablement.
